segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Can I just pull you back for a moment to Gilbert's story, Jacques, because I think it's incredibly important. What it's unique for is that it's actually somebody you have spoken to directly, giving a first-person physical account of an encounter with a non-human being in what sounds like a US military government facility. And there's actually a moment in your diaries, Wednesday, March 12, 2025, where you get from Gilbert a physical description of what he saw. He was apparently brought in as a specialist. He didn't know whether there were other captured or, interestingly enough, volunteer beings, but he had a rough idea of approximately where he was being taken. He couldn't see outside the vehicle, but he was inside a small mountain, some kind of perhaps deep underground military bunker. Inside was a large, well-lit laboratory staffed by men and women wearing uniforms without rank or unit identification. There were no medical procedures or drugs. And then Gilbert says to you he was brought face to face with the alleged entity, and it wasn't a gray: it was over 6 feet tall, it apparently emitted light from different parts of its body, may have been enclosed in some sort of wired suit, test article or containment apparatus, and it apparently communicated through combinations of light and permitted questions concerning psychic functioning. And he had several hours of communication with this being. Now, you've made it clear you accept Gilbert's account. Is this person willing to give evidence to a congressional inquiry, if they're not subject to classified limitations, security oaths or NDAs?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I asked him that, because obviously I did not want to get into something that would take me beyond that range, and he said no, he was not. He asked: do I need a special clearance for this? He has done other work for the military.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: I was analyzing the implications of what you say in the diary about Gilbert. To summarize it, it's more than a psychic once met an alien. What it is, is that a classified US group allegedly possesses or hosts a living non-human intelligent being, and they've been operating a systematic, multidisciplinary communication program with it over time, and Gilbert was brought in as one specialist to conduct controlled communications with it. Do you accept that that's the implication of what you say in the diary?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: This is logical in terms of what we have known for a long time about what the procedure would be. The structure did not go into psychic functioning: the questions that they had been asked were basic physiological and physical questions. They brought him in so that he was authorized to create his own questions and to probe, to see to what extent he could elicit a response that would be a psychic response from that entity. The question is: at what level do they function? We know we have some ability to function on a psychic level, some people can practice this better than others. We know from the SRI work by Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ and others that this can be trained. As you know, I was involved in that project to some extent over several years, and I went through the procedure for an entire year. What Gilbert is describing matches that very well. In other words, there was a procedure.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: You allude, Jacques, to the fact that Gilbert is apparently writing his own book about what he encountered. Can you clarify for me, though: is Gilbert willing to give evidence to the ongoing congressional investigations into this? There are very few people who are willing to give first-person evidence, and if he's not restrained by classification, security oaths or constraints, what's stopping him from coming forward, even confidentially, to a secure <abbr title="Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility">SCIF</abbr> in Congress, and giving this evidence?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I cannot answer for him. He has a long career in helping different projects in a classified setting, so he's quite capable of answering that. What I know is — I don't know that he's writing a book. There is a project for a series of interviews, and I've participated in that, I've given a few interviews about my own work, but I know he's been part of that project. I don't know how it's going to be released, or whether it's going to be released, and I'm not part of the business that owns that data.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: I'm very excited by the Gilbert character, and forgive me for harping on about him. Can I at least clarify: Gilbert is a he?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I don't want to give away any indication. I have not had communication recently, I don't know how far that project has gone. It's their project, and there is a boundary to what I can…

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: But who are they, Jacques? When you say it's their project, you're talking about the individual known by the pseudonym Gilbert and the release of that information. His intent is to release it. I've got to ask you this, and I appreciate you may not want to disclose, but is the person that you're talking about Keith Harary?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: No, I can definitely tell you it's not Keith.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Is it Joseph McMoneagle?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I shouldn't play. It's an interesting game, but there are two or three other names.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Joseph McMoneagle, of course, Jacques, as you and I both know, worked with you at SRI. He was remote viewer number one in the US Army intelligence program. Joe is probably one of the most respected remote viewers known to the US military and the US intelligence community. And I noted, back in Forbidden Science 3, Joe told you about UFO-related material. Joe talked about how a photograph of a disc had inexplicably disappeared from a classified safe under his sole control, and you quoted him saying to you: there must be a higher level of authority that controls UFO data.
